summary.intent: Finish and publish the fix for trail #177 (failing command's JSON error envelope should carry the report's command name and dryRun), then start trail #178: add tests for seven spec criteria that had no asserting test.
summary.outcome: Committed and pushed the #177 fix and opened/edited PR #429. Wrote passing tests for all seven #178 gaps (MX-OUT-02, MX-ERR-06, MX-ERR-07, MX-DISC-02, WS-ID-08, WS-ID-09, VER-CS-03), passed fmt and clippy, committed, pushed test/spec-assertion-gaps, and linked trail 178.

repo: Branch workflow: fetch origin main, branch from origin/main, commit with conventional-commit messages, push with -u, then link the branch to an Entire trail via `entire trail link <n> --repo=gh/orin-dx/callisto ...`.

Specs live in docs/specs/*.json with IDs like WS-ID-09, MX-ERR-06, REL-CMD-12; error codes are documented in docs/errors.md (E007, E101, E102, E012). Behavior changes require updating the corresponding spec entries.
Commits touching behavior need a changeset (.changeset); the test-only commit in #178 required no code, spec, or changeset change.
Quality gate before commit: `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --offline -p <crates> --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
Tests run with `--offline`; the polyglot lifecycle test needs network so it only passes outside the sandbox.
Failure JSON can be preceded by stderr echoed from other tools (e.g. a failed lookup), so error-envelope tests parse from the first `{`.

code.finding: New integration test file that fails `release plan`, `release-pr verify`, `release-pr commit-plan` and `--dry-run version` and checks the error envelope has the right command and dryRun.
Matrix report builder sorts cargo artifacts by artifact name when two share a triple; a unit test was added beside build_matrix_report_same_triple_two_packages_have_distinct_artifact_names.
New end-to-end file covering E101 (two packages resolving to the same tag) and E007 (static and dynamic Python version, before anything is written).

workflow: PR number was looked up via `gh pr list --head <branch> --state all` and the PR then edited with gh pr edit.
Anchor edit targets carefully: an Edit matched three locations and was re-anchored to a unique neighboring test (the engines test).

friction: The first `gh pr edit` compound command printed the number but evidently did not complete, so the number was fetched again and the edit rerun with a corrected body.
An Edit hit three matches and had to be redone with a more specific anchor.
The sort test for two artifacts needed a second edit after the first run before it passed.
The sandbox blocks network, so the polyglot lifecycle test cannot be verified there.
open_items: A message another tool echoes to stderr (e.g. a failed lookup) can still precede the JSON error output; this noise bug is left unfixed.
No PR was opened yet for test/spec-assertion-gaps (trail #178); only the branch was pushed and trail linked.
